attributes.title: Build order
attributes.lede: Keynote’s build inspector, wired to the site’s own logo. Retime it while it runs.

lesson.concept: Named dependencies express intent better than absolute times
lesson.why: The builds name one another with with and after relationships. The compiler resolves start times, and the transport reads those times back instead of recomputing a parallel schedule.
lesson.experiment: Lengthen an earlier build and inspect the dependent starts. Compare Show each beat with Rapid assembly while keeping the dependency graph unchanged.
lesson.pitfall: Maintaining manual timestamps beside the template causes the displayed timeline to disagree with the actual score.
lesson.combine: Combine with presentation gates when some boundaries wait for a person and others follow named build dependencies.
